area: Taskflow open / framework repo profile readiness
finding: `taskflow open --write` is documented as the official operator lane, but in the framework repo it fails in template-only-fallback mode when no opener profile is loaded, then points back to `tasks new` plus `tasks import`; if import is blocked by row 159, the official lane cannot recover.
expectedBehavior: The framework repo should ship or discover a taskflow opener profile for its own task cards, or `taskflow open` should emit a complete copy-paste-safe sequence that cannot enter create/import drift.
evidenceOrRepro: Reproduced on 2026-09-05 with an explicit `--task-id` and `--output`: `taskflow open --write` still returned `ATM_TASKFLOW_TEMPLATE_ONLY_FALLBACK` without a profile. A red regression then proved the bounded case. Source repair commit `e8e8d96d95d39b1ba31cae2c958a61336581d165` now allows the no-profile path only when both task id and output path are explicit; ambiguous no-profile requests remain fail-closed. Focused opener test, typecheck, and touched encoding guard passed.
followUp: Keep the explicit `--task-id` plus `--output` regression in the taskflow opener suite; ambiguous no-profile requests must remain fail-closed and continue to require a profile.
